customers_pdv_name_every.cause: PPBase defect on the D-0019 arrays, independent of the import: a nested field of a multiple relation without '?' matches when any element matches (ppbase/services/filter_parser.py:1268-1282, EXISTS only); PocketBase v0.22.34 requires every element (multi-match, resolvers/record_field_resolve_runner.go:679-681, tools/search/filter.go:184-210)
customers_pdv_name_every.client_impact: a filter or rule on a nested field of buma_customer.pdv, buma_pilotage_ticket.tag or buma_wallet.managers without '?' (here pdv.name ~ ...) selects more records than PocketBase: a list returns records PocketBase leaves out
customers_pdv_name_every.documented_in: D-0025 (remaining PPBase gaps: multi-match of traversals, handled by D-0030)

users_lists_customers_by_role.cause: pre-existing BUMA C3 defect, independent of the import: app/auth/context.py:45-94 (merge_live_auth_context) gives a False default only to isAdmin, to the keys that buma_apps_roles.info.actions declares and to role.*/user.*; an undeclared key of the rule (customer.read, wallet.read, wallet.list) is bound as '' and PostgreSQL refuses '' = TRUE (asyncpg DataError, HTTP 500), even when isAdmin = true already holds. PocketBase v0.22.34 resolves the missing JSON key to NULL and compares it without error (tools/search/filter.go:290-330, resolveEqualExpr): the condition is false
users_lists_customers_by_role.client_impact: HTTP 500 with a plain-text body (text/plain, not the JSON error envelope) instead of 200 or 404 for any record session, admins included, whose role and the buma_apps_roles rows do not declare the key: listing or viewing buma_customer (customer.read) and buma_wallet (wallet.read, wallet.list) fails; with the keys declared, the same rules answer as PocketBase (see declared_permission_keys). Production exposure depends on its roles.permission and buma_apps_roles content (aggregates to measure on the real backup). Cutover blocker until fixed in app/auth/context.py (False default for every key a rule reads) or accepted
users_lists_customers_by_role.documented_in: not yet in docs/decisions-and-divergences.md: to record (D-XXXX)

auth_email_hidden_despite_manage_rule.cause: PocketBase v0.22.34 shows auth emails to admins, the owner and requesters satisfying the collection manageRule (apis/record_helpers.go:216-270; users.manageRule is @request.auth.role.permission.isAdmin = true); PPBase only to superusers and the owner (ppbase/models/record.py:80-101)
auth_email_hidden_despite_manage_rule.client_impact: a record session whose role satisfies users.manageRule (isAdmin) no longer receives the other users' email in lists and views
auth_email_hidden_despite_manage_rule.documented_in: not yet in docs/decisions-and-divergences.md: to record (D-XXXX)

auth_error_message_wording.cause: 401/403 messages of PPBase differ from PocketBase v0.22.34, same status
auth_error_message_wording.client_impact: a client comparing or displaying the 401/403 message text
auth_error_message_wording.documented_in: docs/contracts/c11-auth-import.md section 5; not yet in docs/decisions-and-divergences.md: to record (D-XXXX)

default_thumb_size_serves_original.cause: PocketBase v0.22.34 always serves the 100x100 thumbnail (apis/file.go:27, :163-164; here the one it stored, thumbs_<name>/100x100_<name>); PPBase only the sizes the field declares (ppbase/api/files.py:280-283; the BUMA file fields declare none) and serves the original bytes
default_thumb_size_serves_original.client_impact: ?thumb=100x100 returns the original image (its size and dimensions) instead of a 100x100 thumbnail
default_thumb_size_serves_original.documented_in: not yet in docs/decisions-and-divergences.md: to record (D-XXXX)

empty_date_served_null.cause: PocketBase v0.22.34 serves an empty date as "" (tools/types/datetime.go:44-53); PPBase stores it as SQL NULL and serves null (ppbase/models/record.py:129-133)
empty_date_served_null.client_impact: every empty date field of every record is served null instead of "": a client typing it as a non-null string (Dart String, TypeScript string) receives null, JavaScript new Date(null) gives 1970-01-01 where new Date("") was invalid
empty_date_served_null.documented_in: not yet in docs/decisions-and-divergences.md: to record (D-XXXX)

empty_expand_object.cause: PocketBase v0.22.34 omits expand when nothing was expanded (models/record.go:556-559); PPBase serves expand {} (ppbase/services/expand_service.py:240-242)
empty_expand_object.client_impact: a client testing whether expand exists takes the other branch (empty object instead of no key), e.g. when every relation of the record is an orphan
empty_expand_object.documented_in: D-0025 (remaining PPBase gaps); not yet in docs/decisions-and-divergences.md: to record (D-XXXX)

empty_list_total_pages.cause: PocketBase v0.22.34 totalPages = ceil(0 / perPage) = 0 (tools/search/provider.go:254); PPBase max(1, ...) (ppbase/models/record.py:196-201)
empty_list_total_pages.client_impact: an empty list reports totalPages 1 instead of 0 (pagers, page loops)
empty_list_total_pages.documented_in: not yet in docs/decisions-and-divergences.md: to record (D-XXXX)

error_envelope_code_vs_status.cause: PocketBase v0.22.34 {code, message, data} (apis/api_error.go:12-15), PPBase {status, message, data}
error_envelope_code_vs_status.client_impact: same HTTP status and message: a client reading the body field code of a native error (/api/admins, /api/collections/*, /api/files) gets no value
error_envelope_code_vs_status.documented_in: docs/contracts/c11-auth-import.md section 5 and the D-0025 gap list; not yet in docs/decisions-and-divergences.md: to record (D-XXXX)

failed_login_identity_detail.cause: PPBase adds data.identity validation_invalid_credentials to the 400 of a failed login (ppbase/api/record_auth.py:352-357, ppbase/api/admins.py:172); PocketBase v0.22.34 answers data {}
failed_login_identity_detail.client_impact: same 400 and message; a client that shows or tests the data keys of a failed login (field errors) sees an identity error
failed_login_identity_detail.documented_in: not yet in docs/decisions-and-divergences.md: to record (D-XXXX)

file_content_disposition_missing.cause: PocketBase v0.22.34 sends Content-Disposition inline/attachment with the file name (tools/filesystem/filesystem.go:393-418); PPBase none on its default storage stream (ppbase/api/files.py:1056-1110)
file_content_disposition_missing.client_impact: a browser or downloader gets no file name and no inline/attachment hint from the header (it falls back to the URL name)
file_content_disposition_missing.documented_in: not yet in docs/decisions-and-divergences.md: to record (D-XXXX)

json_content_type_charset.cause: measured: PocketBase v0.22.34 sends JSON answers as application/json; charset=UTF-8 (set by its echo v5 dependency, whose source is not on this server: not verified offline), PPBase as application/json
json_content_type_charset.client_impact: JSON is UTF-8 either way (RFC 8259 section 8.1); only a client that compares the exact Content-Type string differs
json_content_type_charset.documented_in: not yet in docs/decisions-and-divergences.md: to record (D-XXXX)

evidence_scope.statement: Proves that the synthetic snapshot built by PocketBase is imported faithfully (records, rowids, arrays, preserved anomalies, accounts, settings, token secrets, files) and served by PPBase with the sessions PocketBase issued before the import. Does not prove answer parity with PocketBase 0.22.34: every accepted difference of comparison_with_pocketbase is an open divergence, pre-existing and independent of the import, with its cause, client impact and documentation state.
